name: operand-test-0e6612016b/operand_rest_param_only-v.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Supports [`required-params`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#required-params), [`defaultable-params`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#defaultable-params), [`included-record-param`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#included-record-param) and [`rest-param`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#rest-param) in the signature
reason: The signature and indexed accesses are supported, but the asserted outputs depend on the launcher binding command-line operands Riyafa and John to main's string rest parameter. The subset does not cover command-line argument binding; signature support alone does not establish that behavior.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line operands bound to public main(string... s)
test_design_notes: The @args directive supplies two launcher operands, and the output assertions verify their order and values. io:println is instrumentation.
